findings.classification: FALSE POSITIVE — Design Intent / Incorrect Assumption
findings.summary: The claim assumes every test prerequisite must be supplied by package.json and that Node-only hosts are supported. The locked runbook explicitly prescribes serving the static build with python3 -m http.server, while package engines correctly describe Node/npm compatibility rather than all host tools. The workflow fails loudly when python3 is absent and makes no portability promise for minimal Node images or Windows-only hosts.
findings.evidence: reviews/runbook/stack-selection.md:25-41 explicitly prescribes the plain python3 static server; frontend/playwright.config.mjs:10-14 implements it; frontend/package.json:6-20 does not claim a Node-only host contract; DeepSeek independently treated the same observation as non-material and pre-existing.
